summary: Zumbo's Just Desserts is an Australian baking reality competition television program broadcast on the Seven Network. It was developed by the creators of My Kitchen Rules and is hosted by Adriano Zumbo and Rachel Khoo, with Gigi Falanga as assistant. The series was won by a contestant named Kate, who received $100,000 in prize money and had her dessert featured in Zumbo's shop.
one_line: Australian baking reality competition on the Seven Network, hosted by Adriano Zumbo and Rachel Khoo, won by Kate.
